generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: authoring source image for deterministic 2D polygon-mesh conversion in a Godot game prototype
Primary request: one open book viewed from an exact orthographic top-down camera, centered, horizontally symmetrical, with a strong readable silhouette and broad connected low-poly color facets
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat, perfectly uniform solid #ff00ff chroma-key background across the entire canvas; no floor plane, no shadow, no gradient, no texture, no lighting variation, no reflection
Subject: a single fully open book; vertical center spine; left and right pages spread evenly; warm ivory page planes; a muted dark-purple cover visible only around the outer edges; deep near-black outer contour; a restrained muted amber accent may appear only as a small geometric page-edge plane
Style/medium: clean abstract low-poly 2D game art, large contiguous polygonal color planes, crisp hard edges, limited palette, immediately readable as an open book; no realistic paper texture
Composition/framing: square canvas, exact top-down view with no perspective, generous even padding, book fully inside frame, centered and balanced
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, page markings, symbols, illustrations, bookmark, ribbon, hands, desk, props, extra objects, watermark, cast shadow, contact shadow, perspective tilt, isometric angle, soft transparency, glow, halo, or magenta inside the book; background must remain exactly flat #ff00ff up to the crisp subject edge
Output intent: robust chroma-key separation, silhouette extraction, Delaunay triangulation, palette snapping, and runtime polygon animation
